title: Exact offload and hint delivery pass the current functional checks
summary: The current engine-method integration passed 13 pinned-runtime CPU tests and three RTX 2080 Ti hardware tests. Restored and freshly computed continuations matched in both advice modes; authenticated HTTP hints reached the engine.
scope: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct; RTX 2080 Ti, WSL2, dense FP16 TP1, eager TRITON_ATTN. Hardware execution was fresh; retained receipts were verified.
limitations: These small functional cases do not establish performance, general answer quality, hardware fault recovery or other models/devices. CPU transfer-failure tests use fake handlers. The pinned native ARC fallback limitation applies in both modes (see runtime docs). The later registration-refusal guards have CPU regression coverage; hardware tests were not rerun after that change.
decision: Retain the core and its regression coverage. Expand qualification when implementation changes warrant it.
correction: 2026-11-10: clarified the existing upstream ARC limitation and the CPU-only validation boundary of subsequent registration refusal hardening; original measurements unchanged.
